# AI+ International Cooperation Initiative

Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the PRC (MFA), updated September 24, 2025. Full text retrieved.

## Key findings
- China proposed the **AI+ International Cooperation Initiative** at a high-level meeting on the **Global Development Initiative** (held Tuesday, i.e., Sept 23, 2025).
- Framing: AI is "inherently empowering" — not only a technology upgrade but a systematic/comprehensive transformation with profound implications; plays a vital role in advancing the UN 2030 Agenda. Consistent with building a community with a shared future for humanity, efforts should promote deep integration of AI into economic/social development, develop new quality productive forces faster, ensure high-quality development and greater security reinforce each other, and bring AI benefits to all countries including the Global South.
- China calls on all countries to proactively carry out **AI+ campaigns** per national conditions, enhance policy exchange and practical cooperation, and share best practices on the basis of mutual respect and mutual benefit.
- **Five campaigns**:
  1. **"AI+ public well-being"** — harness AI to enhance public services and quality of life: healthcare (disease prevention/control, pharmaceutical research, assisted diagnosis, telemedicine, expand coverage in remote/underdeveloped regions); education (equitable distribution of high-quality education resources, innovation in teaching).
  2. **"AI+ technological advancement"** — lead the paradigm shift in global tech innovation, shorten R&D cycles, propel interdisciplinary studies, seek basic-science breakthroughs, bridge theory and practice.
  3. **"AI+ industrial application"** — revitalize traditional industries, fuel emerging sectors, foster new business forms/models/applications, create jobs, keep industrial/supply chains stable.
  4. **"AI+ cultural prosperity"** — use AI to inherit/promote fine traditional cultures (AI-enabled restoration, digital preservation, immersive exhibition), promote cultural communication and inter-civilization exchanges, preserve world-civilization diversity.
  5. **"AI+ talents cultivation"** — step up joint development/sharing of AI education resources, promote talent exchanges to train AI talents with digital literacy/innovation skills/global vision, establish a system for AI talent cultivation.

## Assessment
- `authoritative: yes` — primary/official: MFA publishes the full text of the AI+ International Cooperation Initiative.
